_meta.description: Operational default brand spec — used by the skill when no per-team `team-brand-spec.json` is provided. Token values (color / typography / spacing / radius / motion / iconography) are evidence-anchored to an 11-service style sweep; identity values (team name, brand, logos) describe a fictional Default Studio so the skill renders coherent output out of the box.
_meta.default_team: Default Studio — a fictional web3 / game studio used as a starting point. Replace every identity field below (team.*, brand.*, logo.*, product_assets.*, ui_screenshots.*, design_system.tokens_repo_url, design_system.figma_library_url) with your team's real values before publishing anything.
how_to_use: 1. Run `python3 scripts/init-brand.py` to stamp this file into `team-brand-spec.json` at your repo root.
2. Replace identity values with your team / product values (logo path, brand name, custom typography if any).
3. Optional: run `python3 scripts/figma-to-brand-spec.py <file-key>` to pull token values from a Figma library.
4. Commit `team-brand-spec.json` to your project repo (no secrets — this is shared, version-controlled).
5. The skill auto-loads `<project>/team-brand-spec.json` when present and falls back to this default when absent.
safety: DO NOT put personal info (real name, personal email, WeChat ID).
DO NOT put secrets (API keys, tokens, signed URLs).
Use absolute paths only for assets inside the project repo, or use URLs to the allowlisted asset host.

team._note: Identity slots — replace every value with your team's real values before shipping.

brand._note: Identity slots. tone_keywords + forbidden_zones are evidence-anchored choices that pair with the token defaults below; replace `name` / `tagline_short` with your real brand.
brand.name: Default
forbidden_zones: Rainbow / sunset gradients as primary identity
Cyberpunk-neon palette by reflex on any web3 brief
Emoji used as a product icon
Default Inter + 16px body + 1.5 line-height applied without intent

watermark._note: OPT-IN ONLY. Default is `enabled: false`. Set `enabled: true` only if your studio explicitly wants one on animation exports.

logo._note: Placeholder SVGs ship under `assets/default-brand/`. They use the `accent.primary` colour from the colour token below so the mark is visually consistent with the rest of the default. Mark aspect 1:1, wordmark aspect 4:1 (median across the 11-service sweep).

colors._note: Surface + text + accent + status tokens with explicit light/dark variants. `accent.primary` is deliberately placed in the gap between blue and purple (#5B7CFA) so it does NOT mimic any of the 11 evidence-set brands (Coinbase #1652F0, OpenSea #2081E2, Farcaster #8A63D2, Phantom violet). Status tokens cite Uniswap's GPL-3.0 Spore design system — see `_source` field.

accent._source: decided neutrally — see references/web3-game-style-stats.md §Aggregate analysis / Color decisions

status._source: Uniswap Spore (GPL-3.0) — see https://github.com/Uniswap/interface/blob/main/packages/ui/src/theme/color/colors.ts and references/web3-game-style-stats.md web3-01

typography._note: Two-slot pattern: `display` and `body`. 8 of 11 evidence-set services use a custom or commissioned typeface — adopters typically swap `display.family` for their custom face. `Inter` (OFL) + the Uniswap system-stack fallback is the open-source-safe default.

display.system_stack: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

body.system_stack: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
body._source: system_stack matches Uniswap Spore body fallback (web3-01 evidence)

mono.system_stack: JetBrains Mono, ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, 'SF Mono', Menlo, Monaco, 'Cascadia Mono', 'Segoe UI Mono', 'Roboto Mono', 'Courier New', monospace
mono._source: mono system_stack directly cites Uniswap Spore mono fallback (web3-01)

_legacy._note: Flat aliases kept for backwards compatibility with skill code that read the old shape.

iconography._note: Lucide is in the default public asset-host allowlist (examples/dot-claude-settings.json). Phosphor is the fallback when an icon doesn't exist in Lucide.

motion._note: No service in the 11-set publishes an enumerated ms scale; values follow Material Motion + Apple HIG spec defaults, already cited in references/animation-best-practices.md.

product_assets._note: Required for physical products. Default Studio is fictional, so all paths are empty — fill in when you have real product imagery, or delete this block if the team only ships digital products.

ui_screenshots._note: Required for digital products (apps / sites / SaaS). Default Studio is fictional — fill in paths to your product screenshots before shipping.

design_system._note: tokens_repo_url + figma_library_url are per-fork placeholders. Spacing / radius / shadow values are evidence-anchored Step 5.2 defaults.

current_project._note: Optional — narrows the scope for this run.
